import re, time
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from scipy.stats import rankdata

base=Path('inputs')
t0=time.time()
print('reading CRISPR', flush=True)
crispr=pd.read_csv(base/'CRISPRGeneEffect.csv', index_col=0, dtype=np.float32, low_memory=False)
print('read CRISPR', crispr.shape, 'sec', round(time.time()-t0,1), flush=True)
t1=time.time()
print('reading expression', flush=True)
expr=pd.read_csv(base/'OmicsExpressionProteinCodingGenesTPMLogp1BatchCorrected.csv', index_col=0, dtype=np.float32, low_memory=False)
print('read expression', expr.shape, 'sec', round(time.time()-t1,1), flush=True)

# Ensure the model metadata contains the matrix model IDs, then pair only models in both assay matrices.
model_ids=pd.read_csv(base/'Model.csv', usecols=['ModelID'], dtype='string')['ModelID']
model_set=set(model_ids.astype(str))
common_ids=[idx for idx in crispr.index.astype(str) if idx in expr.index and idx in model_set]
print('paired models', len(common_ids), 'crispr_only', len(crispr)-len(common_ids), 'expr_only', len(expr)-len(common_ids), flush=True)
crispr=crispr.loc[common_ids]
expr=expr.loc[common_ids]

pat=re.compile(r'"'^(.*) '"\\(["'^()]*)$'"')
def gene_symbol(s):
    m=pat.match(str(s))
    return m.group(1) if m else str(s)
cmap={gene_symbol(c):c for c in crispr.columns}
emap={gene_symbol(c):c for c in expr.columns}
common=sorted(set(cmap)&set(emap))
print('matched gene symbols',len(common), flush=True)

results=[]
missing_stats=[]
constant=[]
for k,sym in enumerate(common,1):
    x=crispr[cmap[sym]].to_numpy(dtype=np.float64, copy=False)
    y=expr[emap[sym]].to_numpy(dtype=np.float64, copy=False)
    mask=np.isfinite(x)&np.isfinite(y)
    n=int(mask.sum())
    if n<2:
        constant.append((sym,n,'too_few'))
        continue
    xr=x[mask]; yr=y[mask]
    if np.all(xr==xr[0]) or np.all(yr==yr[0]):
        constant.append((sym,n,'constant'))
        continue
    rx=rankdata(xr, method='average')
    ry=rankdata(yr, method='average')
    rx-=rx.mean(); ry-=ry.mean()
    denom=np.sqrt(np.dot(rx,rx)*np.dot(ry,ry))
    rho=float(np.dot(rx,ry)/denom) if denom else float('nan')
    if np.isfinite(rho):
        results.append((rho,sym,n,int((~mask).sum())))
    missing_stats.append(int((~mask).sum()))
    if k%4000==0: print('processed',k,flush=True)
results.sort(key=lambda z:(z[0],z[1]))
print('valid correlations',len(results),'undefined',len(common)-len(results),'sec_total',round(time.time()-t0,1),flush=True)
print('missing pair count min/max/median',min(missing_stats),max(missing_stats),float(np.median(missing_stats)),flush=True)
print('most negative 30')
for row in results[:30]: print(row)
print('most positive 5')
for row in results[-5:]: print(row)

expr=read_numeric_matrix(base/'OmicsExpressionProteinCodingGenesTPMLogp1BatchCorrected.csv')
model_set=set(pd.read_csv(base/'Model.csv',usecols=['ModelID'],dtype='string')['ModelID'].astype(str))
expr_ids=set(expr.index.astype(str))
common_ids=[idx for idx in crispr.index.astype(str) if idx in expr_ids and idx in model_set]
crispr=crispr.loc[common_ids]
expr=expr.loc[common_ids]

def gene_symbol(s):
    s=str(s)
    return s.rsplit(' (',1)[0] if s.endswith(')') and ' (' in s else s
cmap={gene_symbol(c):c for c in crispr.columns}
emap={gene_symbol(c):c for c in expr.columns}
common=sorted(set(cmap)&set(emap))
print('paired_models',len(common_ids),'symbol_matches',len(common),'exact_matches',len(set(crispr.columns)&set(expr.columns)),flush=True)
results=[]
for sym in common:
    x=crispr[cmap[sym]].to_numpy(dtype=np.float64,copy=False)
    y=expr[emap[sym]].to_numpy(dtype=np.float64,copy=False)
    mask=np.isfinite(x)&np.isfinite(y)
    x=x[mask]; y=y[mask]
    if len(x)<2 or np.all(x==x[0]) or np.all(y==y[0]):
        continue
    rx=rankdata(x,method='average'); ry=rankdata(y,method='average')
    rx-=rx.mean(); ry-=ry.mean()
    rho=float(np.dot(rx,ry)/np.sqrt(np.dot(rx,rx)*np.dot(ry,ry)))
    results.append((rho,sym,len(x)))
results.sort(key=lambda z:(z[0],z[1]))
print('valid',len(results),'elapsed_sec',round(time.time()-t0,2),flush=True)
for z in results[:25]: print(z)
